The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 3. DD should be made in favour of DCA MRAU payable at AT CHENNAI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Our File Ref No: DPS/MRPU/9/2/23988 1. Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Supply of n-Dodecane as technic al specification annexure attached. 2. Suppliers should upload document duly filled, signed and stamped regarding Self declaration with regar ds to Local content and also ensure that Local content percentage and location of value addition are clearl y mentioned, strictly as per the format of Annexure XI attached in ATC document, otherwise offer will be rejected. 3. Delivery Schedule and conditions: 3.1 Supply is to be effected in tankers in Two Lots only. User will intimate the requirement to the supplier. The material should reach our plant site at NRB Stores , Kalpakkam within 30-45 days of receiving the inti mation from User. 3.2 Tolerance for acceptable quantity: Tolerance for acceptable quantity will be ± 25% of the ordered qua ntity in each instalment/lot. 3.3 n-Dodecane is one of the critical chemicals required for regular operation. Hence, the tanker load of th e chemical shall be dispatched strictly within the stipulated period of 30-45 days from receipt of intimatio n from the user by email. Delay in chemical supply will attract normal liquidated damages. 3.4 Tanker should be sealed by tamper proof seals on all outlets possible including vent line. 3.5 Actual quantity received will be weighed and the payment for it will be made after acceptance. 3.6 Sample from each lot shall be collected upon arrival of the tanker at site and tested at KARP Laborator y for the parameters specified in the Technical Specifications. The test results of KARP Laboratory shall be final and binding for acceptance of the material and release of payment. The supplier shall submit an Anal ytical Test Certificate (ATC), duly issued on the firm’s letterhead or by a laboratory conforming to the Tech nical Specifications, along with each lot. 3.7 In case the test results reported by KARP Laboratory indicate that the material does not confirm to any of the specified requirements, the consignment shall be rejected, irrespective of the findings reported in th

e supplier’s ATC. The rejected tanker/consignment shall be taken back by the supplier at their own risk an d cost, and the supplier shall be responsible for arranging replacement with conforming material. 3.8 Tanker should report only on Central Govt. working days at our main security gate by 9 A.M., so that s ample analysis and unloading can be done on the same day. If the process of sampling and unloading are not completed on the same day, the Tanker will be held for the next day. 3.9 The supplier must intimate about the expected date of arrival at plant site with prior mail intimation. 3.10 Acceptance Criteria: Offers will be evaluated and accepted on lowest technically suitable offer basis. Hence offers of partially quoted suppliers will not be considered for evaluation. 3.11 Compulsory document submission : 3.11.1 Complete analytical report (on Firm’s Letter Head or with seal of the firm) as per the technical speci fications mentioned in the annexure should be supplied along with quotation. Similar analysis on bulk supp ly shall be done at our end before accepting bulk supply. 3.11.2 Submission of the above document is mandatory. In the absence of such evidence along with the bi d, the offer shall be summarily rejected and shall not be considered for further evaluation. 3.12 Unloading at plant Site: The supplier shall furnish the details of delivery line from tanker (Outlet of the tanker and its size and attachment if any) so as to enable the user to arrange for necessary hoses for unlo ading . 3.12 The supplier may submit documents like Purchase Order, Delivery Challan, Completion Certificate of Supply, or any other equivalent document clearly indicating the quantity supplied if available. 4. The compliance sheet should be filled either with numerical value or by agreeing to the specifications b y mentioning the word “ Yes” or “Accepted” against each property or condition of the table. 5. LD will be applicable against default, if made, against the delivery of each lot of consignme nt. 6. Payment will be made on prorata basis in a maximum number of 2 installments. 7. Bank Guarantee shall be from SBI or any nationalized bank except Gramin/Cooperative Bank. 8. NOTE: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) shall also be accepted by buyer in the form of a surety bond. Original Surety bond shall reach to the buyer within 5 working days from the date of op ening of bid 9. Post supply inspection is not allowed. Any offer containing the conditions of post supply inspection will b e summarily rejected. 10. All the other terms & conditions as per the 'buyer added bid specific ATC document' attached shall be adhered to. . 8.
